dataset.description: The research will generate output data primarily in CSV (Comma-Separated Values) format. This data will consist of quantitative measurements of triboelectric properties.

distribution.title:
The purpose of the data collection is to investigate the triboelectric properties of various polymer materials under different conditions. By generating quantitative data on these factors, the research aims to better understand the mechanisms of triboelectric charge generation. This data will support the project's objective to identify optimal conditions for energy harvesting and provide insights into the role of surface interactions in determining the magnitude and polarity of triboelectric charges.
The data originates from controlled laboratory experiments involving the testing of different polymer samples, under various environmental and chemical conditions. The results are recorded in a structured format to allow for thorough analysis and comparison.

dataset.title: DMP

dmp.description:
The Data Management Plan (DMP) is developed relating to the Academic career PhD (doctoral) grant, ID 1031, project ID 5.2.1.1.i.0/2/24/I/CFLA/003, funder of the project: European Commission (EU Recovery and Resilience Facility).
The research investigates the triboelectric properties of polymers, focusing on the influence of physical and chemical surface modifications. The aim is to explore how factors such as surface adhesion, environmental humidity, and solvent interactions affect the generation of triboelectric charge. Special attention is given to understanding the role of adhesion between chemically and structurally identical surfaces in determining the magnitude and polarity of the triboelectric charge. This work seeks to clarify the mechanisms of charge generation and identify optimal conditions for energy harvesting applications.
